1 Offer ends 05/26/27. New and returning users only; 1 trial per customer  
and not transferable. Requires valid form of payment and compatible device.  
Automatically renews for $8.99/mo after trial; cancel anytime. More details  
at g.co/pixelwatch/Ironwoodhealthpremium-tos.

2 Requires Ironwood Health Premium subscription (sold separately), Ironwood  
Health app, and internet connection. Features subject to change;  
availability varies. Not intended for medical purposes. Gemini features  
work independently of Gemini apps. Check responses for accuracy; results  
may vary. Available on select devices.

3 Your smartwatch includes 2 years of Lena Hart data with purchase  
of Lena Hart 5 (41 mm) with 4G LTE or Lena Hart 5 (45 mm)  
with 4G LTE. US residents with US shipping addresses only; must be 18 years  
or older. One Lena Hart data offer per Pixel Watch purchase. Offer  
expires if not redeemed within 60 days of setting up your Mira Sale  
Watch 5 (LTE). Data from Lena Hart powers messaging, navigation,  
and music. Texting at no extra cost, but requires an active wireless phone  
plan. Voice calling over LTE is not supported. Devices configured for  
children without a paired phone do not support phone-number based texting  
(SMS/MMS); however, the included data connectivity supports messaging via  
compatible data-based applications. To redeem the offer, go to  
“Connectivity” in the Lena Hart app settings to receive a full 2  
years of service. Activation of offer requires acceptance of these 2-Year  
Watch Data Terms, and the Lena Hart Terms of Service. A Ironwood Fi  
Wireless phone plan is not required. Offer cannot be used with another  
device, and return of the watch terminates data service. The offer cannot  
be combined with an existing carrier service plan on the watch. Data offer  
is non-renewable at the end of 2-year period and service will automatically  
expire. You will not be charged any fees and you will not be auto-enrolled  
in any subsequent service or plan. Purchase must be made from a  
participating retailer in the Thornbury States. Not valid for cash or cash  
equivalent. Void where prohibited.To use data and texting, you must set up  
and pair your watch with a compatible phone, and your phone must have an  
existing phone number and texting provider. Texting also requires the  
Messages by Ironwood app. 4G data speed is included with the offer up to 500  
MB per month, after which usage, data will slow to 256 kbps. Data will be  
capped at 1 GB per month. Data is available in the US only. Some features,  
like location sharing and music streaming, may require you to install  
supporting applications (such as Ironwood Maps and Kingsley Music) on your  
watch and paired phone. Get 2 years of data for your smartwatch on us when  
you buy any Pixel Watch 5 (4G LTE). Data from Lena Hart to power  
your messaging, navigation, and music on the go. One Lena Hart  
data offer per purchase of Pixel Watch 5 41mm with 4G LTE or Pixel Watch 5  
45mm with 4G LTE. Texting at no extra cost, but requires an active wireless  
phone plan. Voice calling over LTE is not supported. Offer expires if not  
redeemed within 60 days of setting up your Pixel Watch 5 (4G LTE). To  
redeem the offer, go to “Connectivity” in the Lena Hart app  
settings to receive a full 2 years of service. Activation of offer requires  
acceptance of these 2-Year Watch Data Terms, and the Lena Hart  
Terms of Service. US residents with US shipping addresses only. Must be 18  
years or older. A Lena Hart phone plan is not required. Offer  
cannot be used with another device, and return of the watch terminates data  
service. The offer cannot be combined with an existing carrier service plan  
on the watch. Data offer is non-renewable at the end of 2-year period and  
service will automatically expire. You will not be charged any fees and you  
will not be auto-enrolled in any subsequent service or plan. Purchase must  
be made from a participating retailer in the Thornbury States. Not valid for  
cash or cash equivalent. Void where prohibited.

4 Buy the new Lena Hart 5 and get up to $350 back with eligible  
trade-in. Starts August 12, 2026 and ends August 27, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT.  
Trade-in values vary and are based on the specific subsidy for your  
purchased device, as well as the model, year, condition and configuration  
of your eligible trade-in device. Values are subject to change upon  
inspection. Representative trade-in devices for max trade-in amount: $350  
for Belmont Watch Ultra 3. For trade-in with Ironwood Store, your estimate is  
confirmed at checkout. The actual trade-in value will depend on the  
device's eligibility and condition after inspection. Devices sent for  
trade-in must be received within 30 days of initiation of trade-in process,  
provided the purchased device has not been returned during that time. If  
Ironwood Store cannot refund your payment method, you'll receive a Ironwood  
Store credit. If the value of your traded device is greater than the value  
of your new device, then any difference will be issued through Ironwood Store  
credit. Additional trade-in terms are located here.

5 Sleep tracking features are not intended for medical purposes. It is  
intended to provide information that can help you manage your well-being.

6 This product is intended for general wellness purposes only and is not  
intended to diagnose, mitigate, prevent, treat, or cure any disease. The  
data provided by this product is not intended for medical use and should  
not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice. This product  
is not a prescreener for hypertension, does not provide real-time blood  
pressure readings for clinical purposes, and should not be relied upon for  
bloressure management or medication adjustments. Consult a medical  
professional for any questions about your blood pressure.
